SIAM Conference on Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) 2026



Low-discrepancy sequences are deterministic point sets designed to improve upon ordinary IID sampling for numerical integration. This talk discusses how they can serve as effective drop-in replacements for IID sampling in important computational settings.
